summary.text: One of the three sons of Antenor who stood with Hector, Polydamas, and Aeneas when battle raged about the ships — a namesake of Polybus the Ithacan suitor and of other Polybus figures, but Homer fixes this man among the Dardanian princes.

story.text: When the fight turned grim about the hollow ships, the Trojans gathered about great Hector, peerless Polydamas, godlike Aeneas, and the three sons of Antenor — Polybus, goodly Agenor, and young Acamas, like to the immortals.
